JVT2.depth: at most 127 minus outer array/object nodes
JVT2.object_order: strictly increasing decoded UTF8 byte keys, no duplicate; corresponds exactly to a serde Map container

tags.8: count:u32le then (key_length:u32le, raw UTF8 key, child node)

authority.hash: SHA256(TRNM-PON1\0 || tag_length:u16le || tag || part_length:u32le || canonical ResponseAuthority JSON)
authority.signature: normal RFC8032 Ed25519 over the 32-byte authority digest, not Ed25519ph

byte_order: local scalar fields little endian; original wire frame length u32 big endian
common_preconditions: input, output, work are valid disjoint regions
work and output are exclusively owned for the duration of a call
helpers are private and do not admit arbitrary offsets or overlapping caller buffers

encode.input: TRNMAS01 owner context280 || terminal:u8 || outcome:u8 0 success/1 error || zero6 || seed32 || JVT2(outer1) or full UTF8 Error::to_string text
encode.output: complete 4-byte BE framed original authenticated response
encode.return: frame length 5..2097156; errors FFFFFFE0 context shape, E1 invalid Value/UTF8, E2 depth, E3 frame/tape limit, E4 capacity, E5 seed/server mismatch, E6 internal invariant

number.input: 0:u8 || exact JSON numeric token; or 1:u8 || power_exponent:u64le in 0..308
number.number_output: u64 numeric bits/value, u64 kind(0 U64/1 I64 bits/2 F64 bits), u64 exact canonical flag, u64 canonical text length, 24 bytes NUL-padded text

sign.wipe: es_wipe clears exactly work[0,141568), not work tail, readbuf input, native stack or registers

value_encode.input: JVT2 typed finite serde Value container
value_encode.return: serialized byte length 1..2097152; errors FFFFFFF0 invalid tape, FFFFFFF1 depth, FFFFFFF2 frame/tape limit, FFFFFFF3 capacity

value_wire.helper: jv_parse(a,start,end,w,outer)->u64 next or U64_MAX; w[64..72] canonical flag

verify.input: TRNMAR01 owner context 280 bytes || framed original response || optional subsequent frame
verify.output: five u64: consumed frame, Value offset from frame prefix, Value bytes, terminal, ok; authority digest32; three u64 nonce,generation,reserved0

return.1: NeedMore finite capture, corresponding original FRAME_EOF

nonclaims: trusted context is supplied by a real owner, not authentication booleans
terminal byte is wire data, not durable commit or retry authority
no PQ route selection or PQ key ownership
finite fixture has no production streaming/deadline/socket owner
stack secret erasure has a retained actual FAIL for raw signing kernel
constant time ISA proof and full key custody remain OPEN
